meta.name: consciousness-council
meta.description: Run a multi-perspective Mind Council deliberation on any question, decision, or creative challenge. Use this skill whenever the user wants diverse viewpoints, needs help making a tough decision, asks for a council/panel/board discussion, wants to explore a problem from multiple angles, requests devil's advocate analysis, or says things like "what would different experts think about this", "help me think through this from all sides", "council mode", "mind council", or "deliberate on this". Also trigger when the user faces a dilemma, trade-off, or complex choice with no obvious answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从多角度审视问题，辅助决策与创意发散
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常面临复杂选择，需要多视角辅助思考
copy.tagline_en: Examine issues from multiple angles to aid decisions and creative exploration
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face complex choices and need multi-perspective thinking support

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会针对你的问题或决策，召唤多个不同思维风格的“议员”进行结构化讨论，最后给出综合分析和行动建议。
howto.when: 当你提出复杂问题、面临两难选择、需要多角度分析，或说出“council mode”、“mind council”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 council 模式分析一下要不要换工作。
say.note: Claude 会召唤多个议员从不同角度讨论你的职业决策。

say.text: 启动快速议会，讨论周末旅行计划。
say.note: 使用3位议员，给出简短回应。

say.text: 用深度议会模式，分析这个商业策略的优缺点。
say.note: 使用6位议员，进行更深入的推理。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will summon multiple council members with different thinking styles to deliberate on your question or decision, then synthesize their perspectives into actionable insights.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you face a complex question, dilemma, or trade-off, or say keywords like "council mode", "mind council", "deliberate on this", etc.

say_en.text: Help me analyze whether to change jobs using council mode.
say_en.note: Claude will summon multiple members to discuss your career decision.

say_en.text: Start a quick council for weekend travel plans.
Use deep council mode to analyze this business strategy.
